settings.label: Base URL
settings.description: The endpoint's OpenAI API root, for example http://localhost:8000/v1.

settings.label: API key
settings.description: Sent as a bearer token. Leave empty for endpoints without one.

settings.label: Models
settings.description: Model ids the endpoint serves, comma separated. The first is the default for smart, balanced and code; the last for fast.

settings.label: Provider id
settings.description: The id tier routing and the ledger use. Lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes, underscores.
